$comment: buzz-axiru config. One file: policy controls, the downstream payment MCP server to gate, and notification wiring. Amounts are integer strings in minor units (cents for USD). Keys starting with $ are ignored. Edit and restart the bridge.

controls.$comment: Deterministic spend policy, evaluated locally on every decision.

per_agent_daily_cap.$comment: Denies an agent's spend once its trailing-24h authorized total reaches the cap. USD 100,000.00.

single_payment_ceiling.$comment: Routes any single payment at or above the threshold to a human. USD 25,000.00.

counterparty_allowlist.$comment: Anything not in this list is denied. Ids must match [A-Za-z0-9_.:@/-]+. Gated tools with no counterparty mapping report as tool:<tool_name>; allowlist that id if you use the allowlist without a counterparty_field.

business_hours.$comment: Outside 09:00-17:00 in this timezone, spend is routed to a human instead of allowed.

$downstream_example.$comment: Set downstream to an object like this, or to an array of them, to turn on gate mode: the bridge spawns each server as a child process, re-exposes their tools under one merged namespace, and intercepts every payment-class call. An array is how you get around Buzz handing an agent exactly one MCP server: the gate takes that slot and fans out. Each entry may set name (defaults to the command basename, must be unique) and tool_prefix (exposed names become <tool_prefix><tool>, which is also what payment_tools patterns match). Colliding exposed names are a startup error, so give one of the servers a prefix.
$downstream_example.name: buzz-dev

$downstream_example.$comment: The payment server, prefixed so shell tools keep their plain names and the gate patterns can target money tools only. Replace PIN_REVIEWED_VERSION with an exact package version you reviewed; never launch an unpinned payment server via npx.
$downstream_example.name: payments

$payment_tools_example.$comment: Which exposed tools are payment-class, and how to read the amount out of their arguments. Patterns match the EXPOSED name, so they include any tool_prefix. Patterns support * as a wildcard. FAIL CLOSED: if downstream is set and payment_tools is null, EVERY tool from EVERY configured server is gated, shell tools included. Gating pay_* only, as below, keeps the shell usable while every money tool stays behind policy. Field paths are dot-separated into the tool call arguments; amounts must be non-negative integers in minor units.

$approval_ttl_comment: How long a parked approval stays decidable, in seconds. After this it expires: it can no longer be granted and is never executed. null disables expiry (not recommended).
$agent_pubkey_comment: The Nostr pubkey (64-char hex or npub) decisions are attributed to in gate mode. Usually set per instance via BUZZ_AXIRU_AGENT_PUBKEY instead. If neither is set, decisions attribute to the all-zeros pubkey and all unattributed agents share one daily cap; buzz-axiru doctor reports this as not ready.

buzz.$comment: Set channel_id to a Buzz channel UUID to post approval requests there via the buzz CLI. The CLI must be on PATH and BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY / BUZZ_RELAY_URL must be set for the bridge's own identity.
